typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblOpicsTradeRepairStaging_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		BR as string,
		DEALNO as string,
		SEQ as string,
		PRODTYPE as string,
		CMNE as string,
		INPUTDATE as timestamp,
		CCY as string,
		CCYAMT as decimal(19,4),
		TRAD as string,
		PORT as string,
		COST as string,
		BOODATE as timestamp,
		VOPER as string,
		IOPER as string,
		VDATE as timestamp,
		PRODUCT as string,
		DEALSRCE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OpicsPlusRepairQueueDLDT	source(output(
		BR as string,
		DEALNO as string,
		SEQ as string,
		PRODTYPE as string,
		CMNE as string,
		INPUTDATE as timestamp,
		CCY as string,
		CCYAMT as decimal(19,4),
		TRAD as string,
		PORT as string,
		COST as string,
		BOODATE as timestamp,
		VOPER as string,
		PRODCODE as string,
		IOPER as string,
		VDATE as timestamp,
		DEALSRCE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OpicsPlusRepairQueueFXDH	source(output(
		dealno as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
OpicsPlusRepairQueueDLDT derive({Copy of CMNE} = CMNE,
		{Copy of CCY} = CCY,
		{Copy of VOPER} = VOPER,
		{Copy of DEALSRCE} = DEALSRCE,
		{Copy of BR} = BR,
		{Copy of DEALNO} = DEALNO,
		{Copy of PRODUCT} = PRODUCT,
		{Copy of SEQ} = SEQ,
		{Copy of COST} = COST,
		{Copy of PRODTYPE} = PRODTYPE,
		{Copy of PORT} = PORT,
		{Copy of TRAD} = TRAD,
		{Copy of IOPER} = IOPER) ~> DataConversion1
OpicsPlusRepairQueueFXDH derive({Copy of CCY} = CCY,
		{Copy of PRODCODE} = PRODCODE,
		{Copy of BR} = BR,
		{Copy of SEQ} = SEQ,
		{Copy of PORT} = PORT,
		{Copy of DEALNO} = DEALNO,
		{Copy of VOPER} = VOPER,
		{Copy of CMNE} = CMNE,
		{Copy of COST} = COST,
		{Copy of DEALSRCE} = DEALSRCE,
		{Copy of TRAD} = TRAD,
		{Copy of IOPER} = IOPER,
		{Copy of PRODTYPE} = PRODTYPE) ~> DataConversion3
DataConversion1 derive(LoadDate = toString((currentTimestamp()))) ~> LoadDT
DataConversion3 derive(LoadDate = toString((currentTimestamp()))) ~> LoadDate
LoadDT,LoadDate union(byName: true) ~> UnionAll1
UnionAll1,LookupLKPTABLE lookup({Copy of DEALNO} == LookupLKPTABLE@dealno,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
Lookup filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		PRODTYPE as string,
		CCYAMT as integer,
		PORT as string,
		INPUTDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		VOPER as string,
		DEALSRC as string,
		TRAD as string,
		BR as string,
		COST as string,
		BOODATE as string,
		PRODUCT as string,
		CCY as string,
		DEALNO as string,
		LOADDATE as string,
		SEQ as string,
		CMNE as string,
		IOPER as string,
		VDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		PRODTYPE = {Copy of PRODTYPE},
		CCYAMT,
		PORT = {Copy of PORT},
		INPUTDATE,
		VOPER = {Copy of VOPER},
		DEALSRC = {Copy of DEALSRCE},
		TRAD = {Copy of TRAD},
		BR = {Copy of BR},
		COST = {Copy of COST},
		BOODATE,
		PRODUCT = {Copy of PRODUCT},
		CCY = {Copy of CCY},
		DEALNO = {Copy of DEALNO},
		LOADDATE = LoadDate,
		SEQ = {Copy of SEQ},
		CMNE = {Copy of CMNE},
		IOPER = {Copy of IOPER},
		VDATE),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblOpicsTradeRepairStaging_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblOpicsTradeRepairStaging
